description_en: Creates a project. You can create document standard, image standard, and video standard projects. Create a project based on the content type that you want to process
description_zh: 目前支持创建文档标准型、图片标准型和视频标准型项目，请根据需要处理的内容类型创建相应项目
kebab_example: aliyun imm put-project --project immtest --service-role AliyunIMMDefaultRole --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutProject

parameters.help_en:
The project name.

The project name must be 1 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot be ALL (reserved word)
parameters.help_zh:
项目名称。

项目名称的长度限制为1~50字符，只能包含英文字母，数字和短横线（-），必须以英文字母开头，且不能为ALL（保留字）
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en:
The service role that grants Intelligent Media Management (IMM) permissions to access other cloud resources such as Object Storage Service (OSS). Default value: AliyunIMMDefaultRole.

You can also create an authorization role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console. For more information, see Create a regular service role (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html)
parameters.help_zh:
服务角色，授权给IMM服务以访问其他云资源（例如OSS）的权限，默认值为AliyunIMMDefaultRole。

您也可以通过RAM控制台创建授权角色。具体操作，请参见创建普通服务角色 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html)
parameters.name: service_role
